messages:
ana (mkt): quick kickoff — we need a crisp launch narrative for the benchmark page and webinar. two visuals: a cost-per-1k_tokens scatter and a token-phase waterfall. keep copy lean for devs and platform buyers.
liam (growth): agree. goal: capture signups and route intent. propose CTAs: 'Explore results' and 'Request a dedicated run'. second -> sales queue.
dev (data): provisional numbers from conversational-agent-v2 workload (med p50, tail p95, $/1k):
```
FastModel: p50 85ms, p95 320ms, $0.60 /1k
SmallQuant: p50 150ms, p95 510ms, $0.20 /1k
Balanced: p50 110ms, p95 380ms, $0.35 /1k
```
These are with batch=8, seq=2048, KV cache enabled. I'll publish CSV and harness link.
nina (design): visual notes: scatter uses size=throughput (tokens/sec); waterfall breaks cost into prompt, generation, KV. mobile should stack charts vertically. hero badge: 'Real workload measurements'.
omar (product): messaging options: Variant X: 'Production economics for teams' Variant Y: 'Ship fast, spend smart'. Recommend A/B test both. Add a tiny blurb about routing: 'Requests route by SLA then cost; automatic fallback to compatible variants reduces outages.'
nana (mkt): inbound routing plan: use HubSpot fields: chosen_CTA, org_tier, wants_dedicated_run. Zapier -> SDRs for dedicated runs. Track conversion cohorts per variant.
liam (growth): webinar plan: 25-min bench walkthrough + 20-min Q&A, rehearse Tue. Target: engineering leads + platform owners. Offer a post-webinar dedicated bench slot as a follow-up for high-intent orgs.
dev (data): methodology snippet for page: dataset=conversational-agent-v2, seq_len_distribution=short/med/long, batching=batch=8, quant=bitsandtradeoffs. one-line per item.
nina (design): will ship mock PNGs + small interactive hover specs by EOD tomorrow.
omar (product): FAQ suggestion: 'Can I reproduce these numbers?' -> 'Yes — we publish the harness and offer guided reproductions for customers.'
nana (mkt): next steps: dev upload CSV + harness link, nina finalize visuals, liam wire tracking and routing, omar final copy. reconvene Fri 9am PT.
